integrity: A complete symbolic characteristic-two proof, executable full-state check for all scans through five pages, and separately constructed binary-matrix checks through forty pages are supplied. Finite computations corroborate but do not replace the analytic proof. Originality is qualified by possible unindexed prior equivalent results.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for fixed single-visit sequential self-inclusive parity scans on the labelled triangular-book/complete-bipartite pair over the binary field. Does not determine trajectories for arbitrary repeated-word scans, affine forcing, randomized updates or general graph edits. Independent expert audit is outstanding.
title: A one-edge parity reversal in sequential XOR dynamics on triangular books
